description: Start here in a three.js project you do not know, or when something is broken and you do not know where to begin. From the files alone (no browser): versions and imports, why the scene shows nothing, assets that will not load, removed APIs for the installed release, colour, performance and cleanup — grouped by cause, most urgent first, each with its fix and whether three_fix does it, then numbered next steps. For the page itself use three_check afterwards. Read-only.

detail.description: brief (capped, short) or full (everything); default brief

path.description: Project folder, or a file or folder in it (relative to the server's folder; default: the project).

three.description: Path to a three package folder, when it is not in node_modules above the project.

name: three_doctor
title: What is wrong, and in which order to fix it
